title: Cosmic Dog and Egg
description: A large green dog with intricate black patterns and a small red creature in its ear stands on a sandy alien landscape, facing a cheerful anthropomorphic egg character in a red spacesuit holding a tiny moon on a stick. The egg stands atop a striped orange planet with rings, surrounded by smaller floating planets against a starry purple sky with a large crescent celestial body.
